title: 质量评估多目标指标权重

standard.summary: 各评估指标聚合为综合分时的权重，JSON 对象格式如 {"clip_score":1,"fid":0.5}。缺失的指标不会被伪造为 0 分参与聚合。
standard.effect: 综合评分按权重加权；某指标因缺少依赖（如 FID 缺真图目录）被跳过时，该项从聚合中剔除而非按 0 计入，避免误导性总分。
standard.whenToUse: 多指标（fid、clip_score、lpips）同时开启且各指标对你的目标重要性不同时；想把综合分用于自动化对比/选型时。
standard.avoidWhen: 只开一个指标时无需配置；权重语义未想清楚前直接看分项指标更靠谱。

standard_en.summary: The weights used when the evaluation metrics are aggregated into an overall score, as a JSON object such as {"clip_score":1,"fid":0.5}. A missing metric is not faked as a 0 and pulled into the aggregate.
standard_en.effect: The overall score is a weighted sum; when a metric is skipped for want of a dependency (FID with no real-image directory, say) it is dropped from the aggregate rather than counted as 0, which avoids a misleading total.
standard_en.whenToUse: When several metrics (fid, clip_score, lpips) are on at once and they matter differently for your goal; when you want the overall score for automated comparison or selection.
standard_en.avoidWhen: No configuration is needed with only one metric on; before you have thought the weighting through, reading the individual metrics is more reliable.

advanced.principle: 不同指标量纲与方向不同（FID 越低越好、CLIP Score 越高越好），聚合前需按指标语义归一；权重表达业务侧的重要性排序。「缺失不伪造 0」是防止「没测到」被当成「测得差」的报告完整性约束。
advanced.intervention: configs_validators.py：支持配置块（metric_weights）与扁平 JSON 字符串两种来源，解析为 dict[str,float]；quality/validation_suite.py 把权重传入套件构建。
advanced.expectedImpact: 只影响综合分呈现，不影响训练与分项指标本身。
advanced.tradeoffs: 权重是主观先验，跨套件比较时必须保持权重一致（建议连同 suite_id 一起管理）。

advanced_en.principle: Different metrics have different scales and directions (lower FID is better, higher CLIP Score is better), so they must be normalized per metric semantics before aggregation; the weights express the business-side importance ranking. "A missing measurement is never faked as 0" is a report-integrity constraint preventing "not measured" from being read as "measured badly".
advanced_en.intervention: configs_validators.py: supports both a config block (metric_weights) and a flat JSON string, parsed into dict[str,float]; quality/validation_suite.py passes the weights into suite construction.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Affects only the composite score presentation, not training or the individual metrics themselves.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Weights are a subjective prior; cross-suite comparisons must keep the weights identical (recommend managing them together with suite_id).
advanced_en.codePath: configs_validators.py: metric_weights JSON parsing; quality/validation_suite.py: metric_weights passed in
